body.objective: Freeze the local action, BV field content and radial-quartet reduction for the complex conformal compensator before any causal or background-specific construction, so the compensator programme has an independently reusable algebraic source of truth.
body.stop_condition: Declare the complete bounded-derivative local action ansatz for Phi=rho exp(i theta) coupled to pure Weyl gravity, including the conformal rho^2 R term, radial and phase kinetic terms, admissible Weyl-invariant potential, internal U(1) choice and the formal Wess-Zumino functional kept at its correct hbar lifecycle. Fix transformations g->exp(2 sigma)g, rho->exp(-sigma)rho, theta invariant, tau=-log(rho/f), and g_hat=(rho/f)^2 g. Derive the full minimal and nonminimal BV differential, antifield equations, odd pairing and cotangent lift from the action; prove the classical master equation, nilpotency, cyclicity and real structure exactly. Construct the tau/Weyl-ghost quartet contraction in the formal rho!=0 chart and compute the reduced g_hat-plus-theta quadratic action and pairing. Determine the exact Einstein-Hilbert coefficient, Planck-scale convention, cosmological term, residual scalar spectrum and every independent higher-curvature coupling after rho=f gauge fixing. Classify whether theta is physical, gauged or globally charged under each declared internal-symmetry choice. Export strict schemas, sparse operators, symbolic action identities and independent mutation tests. Stop before causal Green operators, Berger clock backgrounds, anomaly coefficients or quantum states.
body.current_gate: single action-derived local BV and quartet-reduction preflight for the complex compensator-clock theory
